newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday after yarn orders from abroad eased off before the end-year holiday season, dealers said.

"A sharp fall in orders of cotton yarn from abroad due to holidays has slowed cotton buying by textile mills. Low buying interest in cotton kept the market steady. It is likely to open stable on Thursday," dealer Iftikhar Ahmed of Lorica Pvt Ltd said.
In the kerb market, the rate for NIAB-78 variety remained unchanged at 2,435 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the dealer said.
